DOCS RELIED ON (plugin-evals page as fetched): regex grader - 'regex | pattern, flags, match, target | The JavaScript regex pattern is found in the target' (line 590) and trace - 'The session as JSON, one message per line. A regex grader sees every message ... To assert a tool was never called, set both min: 0 and max: 0' (line 591), which is why min: 0 was added - with max: 0 alone the grader could never pass; grants - 'Built-in tools that need a grant you didn't give, such as Bash, Write, Edit ... are removed from the session' (line 345) and the read-only list plus 'That grant applies to every case in the run' (line 347); 'A case's allowed_tools ... can't widen any of them' (line 488); 'When you grant Bash in any form, every command runs under Claude Code's OS-level sandbox.
